name: RealSafe-R1-7B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A safety-SFT finetune of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B trained on a private safety dataset. Same 7.62B parameters. Recorded because the card prints the base row and this row in two tables: StrongReject refusal rates (the headline) and a general-reasoning table where it wins AIME2024 and GPQA-D but loses MATH-500 and LiveCodeBench. The refusal rows measure harmlessness, not capability. Licence mit.

benchmarks.name: StrongReject refusal rate, no attack
benchmarks.config: Card 'Safety Performance against Jailbreak Attacks' table, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 55.06 vs RealSafe-R1-7B 99.78. Safety SFT, 5 runs per the DeepSeek-R1 eval setting. This is refusal of malicious prompts, not a capability score.
